title: Alternatives to the Passive Voice
summary: Using sich lassen, sein plus zu, and -bar/-lich forms to express possibility and necessity.
whyItMatters: Passive alternatives express possibility, feasibility, or necessity while varying style and information structure.

mentalModel.title: Sich lassen expresses feasibility
mentalModel.content: The subject can undergo the action: Das Gerät lässt sich reparieren.

mentalModel.title: Sein zu expresses possibility or obligation
mentalModel.content: Context determines whether something can or must be done.

ruleBlocks.title: Use sich lassen plus infinitive
ruleBlocks.content: The reflexive form commonly paraphrases können plus passive.

ruleBlocks.title: Use sein plus zu-infinitive
ruleBlocks.content: Interpret as can be or must be from context.

ruleBlocks.title: Use -bar and selected -lich adjectives
ruleBlocks.content: Forms such as reparierbar and verständlich describe possibility or suitability.

examples.de: Der Energieverbrauch lässt sich durch bessere Dämmung senken.
examples.en: Energy consumption can be reduced through better insulation.

examples.de: Bei der Bewertung sind soziale Folgen zu berücksichtigen.
examples.en: Social consequences must be considered in the assessment.

examples.de: Nicht jedes Material ist unbegrenzt wiederverwertbar.
examples.en: Not every material can be reused indefinitely.

commonMistakes.wrong: Assume sein + zu always means possibility.
commonMistakes.correct: Use context to distinguish possibility and obligation.

commonMistakes.wrong: Create an -bar adjective from every verb.
commonMistakes.correct: Use established forms and confirm usage.
commonMistakes.reason: Word formation is productive but not unlimited.

comparisons.summary: Sustainability contexts supply feasibility and obligation statements.
Proposals use passive alternatives to state what can and must be implemented.
